name: Joan Borysenko
reason: Health rule and too thin: her own site (joanborysenko.com) presents her as a pioneer of integrative and mind-body medicine ('Integrating Science & Spirituality for Your Best Health'), and most of her books are health-led (Minding the Body, Mending the Mind; The Power of the Mind to Heal; Fried; The PlantPlus Diet Solution). Once those are left out, only one book has an ISBN on a page we may read (Guilt is the Teacher, Love is the Lesson; the rest link to hayhouse.com, which is off limits), her one group course started on 3 or 10 Nov 2026 (cut-off), and her site shows no videos, leaving spiritual mentoring ($595/month) as the only current offering.
